hypotheses.justification: The proof never uses it. Forward direction: CompactSpace and TotallyDisconnectedSpace are transported along the homeomorphism P.equiv.symm.toHomeomorph using Homeomorph.compactSpace and Homeomorph.totallyDisconnectedSpace, neither of which needs T2. Backward direction: `ProfiniteGrp.of` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Category/ProfiniteGrp/Basic.lean:81) only requires [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]. Its docstring says the Hausdorff condition can be omitted, because a totally disconnected group has {1} closed and is therefore Hausdorff. `FiniteGroupPresentation.ofProfiniteGrp` then gives the presentation. So the theorem and its proof go through unchanged without [T2Space G]. The trivial group needs no special treatment.
